run_attribute_inference: run attribute inference to compute softmax probabilities and attach them to predicted instances
compute_attribute_loss: compute the cross-entropy attribute prediction loss per attribute type for training
create_attribute_output_layers: create an AttributeOutputLayers module with one linear layer per attribute type for prediction
forward_attribute_head: forward feature tensors through attribute output layers to get predictions or training loss
review_attribute_head: review the attribute_head module for attribute inference, loss computation, and output layer design
